simple: Protects computers, servers, cloud workloads and accounts in one platform with one agent. AI right on the device blocks malware and ransomware and stops the attack on its own: ends the process, cuts the computer off from the network, restores encrypted files with one click (rollback). Protects servers, virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes (CWPP); controls the connection of USB drives and other devices and the host firewall; has a remote console (Remote Shell). Detects attacks on accounts in Active Directory and cloud directories (ITDR) — credential theft, privilege escalation, lateral movement — and can disable a compromised account or require a password change. SentinelOne experts continuously hunt for threats in your environment (Managed Threat Hunting). The Purple AI assistant answers questions in plain language. Event history is kept for 90 days. The agentic AI SOC analyst and 24/7 MDR cost extra.
